items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: She said, “Look it’s your gig, you’re my musical director, it’s your gig, get my charts.”

ctx.x: And you had to like get them that way?

Yes. Mingus would sing out parts. He’d sing out the things he’d want. It wasn’t until later that he started to work with Sy Johnson. He was working with Jimmy Knepper first. And Jimmy Knepper used to help him to write out his parts. Then later when he got older and he couldn’t really write anymore, he started to get that disease, he got Sy Johnson to help him. But when Knepper was working with him he’d sing thing to Knepper and Knepper would write them down and then they’d put it together. And he used to do that…
Did you get a chance to hear them before the gig?
